I told him the simplest options are for Dana to send it to Pree herself, or to share it with him first. If he pastes the draft into the DM, I'll check it for finance figures. Then I'll either save it for Pree or ask Anselm or June to approve. I haven't filed an approval request, since I can't see the draft or tell whether it needs one.
